whyItMatters.title: Communication
whyItMatters.text: Explaining what I'm building — live, to strangers — made me better at stand-ups, demos and writing clear docs.

whyItMatters.title: Audience feedback
whyItMatters.text: Comments are a free usability test. I turn viewer feedback into bug fixes and features, the same loop teams run with users.

whyItMatters.title: Consistency
whyItMatters.text: Posting on a schedule taught me to plan, hit deadlines and ship small improvements instead of waiting for perfect.
